LESSON: DATA INTERPRETATION (GROUPED DATA)

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Data Handling and Probability
Topic 5.1: Data Interpretation (Grouped Data)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Data Interpretation (Grouped Data), part of Data Handling and Probability in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we interpret data?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collect data and work out an appropriate class width.

2. tally the data and represent it in a frequency distribution table.

3. recognize the modal class from a set of grouped data.

4. work out the mean from different sets of grouped data.

5. use the frequencies to determine the median class of grouped data.

6. work out the median from different sets of grouped data.

7. use IT devices or other materials to determine the mean and median of grouped data.

8. use digital devices or other materials to search for distances from school or home to health facilities using different roads or routes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collect data and work out an appropriate class width.
2. tally the data and represent it in a frequency distribution table.
3. recognize the modal class from a set of grouped data.
4. work out the mean from different sets of grouped data.
5. use the frequencies to determine the median class of grouped data.
6. work out the median from different sets of grouped data.
7. use IT devices or other materials to determine the mean and median of grouped data.
8. use digital devices or other materials to search for distances from school or home to health facilities using different roads or routes.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Data Interpretation (Grouped Data) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to Learn: learner collects, organises, and interprets data.

● Critical thinking and Problem-solving: learner discusses and determines the modal class, mean, and median of grouped

data.

● Digital Literacy: as the learner uses IT or other materials to determine the mean and median of grouped data.

Values:
Respect: as the learner works together with peers to collect data from the immediate environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: learner collects data that may relate to the population.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● Integrated Science: learner interprets data related to different organisms and materials.

● The learner relates analysing and interpreting data in different social aspects learnt in Social Studies.
